# Orvio 0.17

- Orvio opens straight away with your saved playlist; no more waiting at start-up.
- Automatic refreshes run unseen and swap in the new lists when done: no "Loading…" and no red error.
- New default: refresh every 6 hours, also while Orvio is closed, so your list is usually fresh before you open it.
- Adding a playlist or tapping Refresh now still shows the progress.
